content.comment_body: A program requires 8 inputs. To avoid the cost of adding expansion, I have set up my program so it initializes when power is applied to my [product_name] [article_no]. Is there any risk of program loss if the device remains inactive for a long period?
The program is stored on EEPROM in the [product_name], making it safe from power failures.

A new question posted by [user_name] was moved to a separate thread regarding [product_name] [article_no] connection with [product_name]; issue described as repeated PLC rebooting. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user was concerned about losing the program if the [product_name] ([article_no]) stayed powered off or idle for an extended time. The discussion confirmed that the program is stored in EEPROM, ensuring protection against power failures and easing concerns about data loss.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] to maintain its stored program reliably, even during long periods without power, and to be robust against data loss under various operational conditions.
